findings.detail:
I re-verified every load-bearing paint mechanism against live source + one web check. CLEAR on 4 of 5 named mechanisms; 1 genuinely under-specified.

GOO-OR-GLASS PER-FRAME SWAP — CLEAR. morph-bridge.css verified at exactly 159L: merge-2-plate, clip-path inset() necked on --dock-morph-t (lines 109-149), compositor-only (will-change: clip-path/transform/opacity; NO width/height anim). The 1→N detach generalization is honest net-new topology. The goo SVG filter IS demo-resident (morph-showcase.vue:242-257, feGaussianBlur stdDev=7 + feColorMatrix A-channel threshold "0 0 0 20 -9" + feComposite atop) → the "promote to library mount" is factually accurate + buildable (glass-refract.css data-URI + WatercolorDot per-instance-filter precedents exist). The WebKit goo-vs-glass constraint is SPEC-CONFIRMED (Filter Effects L2 Backdrop Root atomicity), and the swap rule IS stated (goo during neck / glass at rest / sub-perceptual --split-t threshold). NB the demo bridge plates use radial-gradient NOT backdrop-filter (morph-bridge.css:72) so the demo never exercises the constraint — but the fission PIECES are real glass, so the swap is genuinely load-bearing and correctly named. Budget π correctly de-risked: manual real-Safari-26-Metal p50 (webkit Playwright project carries NO ANGLE/throttle by construction, 4× is CDP-only), BLOCKED-ON BE.W-VIZ-PARITY-METAL. Buildable.

AMBIENT-HUE HISTOGRAM — CLEAR. The 32×32 getImageData per-pixel loop is verified at useGlassBackdropLuminance.ts:248-264; a 12-bucket chroma×alpha-weighted OKLCh histogram is a zero-cost free-rider in the SAME loop. cssToOklch/oklchToLinear exist in /color; proof:single-color-core exists (the no-hand-rolled-conversion fence holds). The bias seam (--glass-ambient-strength → color-mix on --glass-tint-source) rides the EXISTING ladder.css:43-120 cascade — ZERO new compositing seam; ladder.css:33 comment already anticipates "a sampled backdrop hue." Gray→null hue is correct by construction (low-chroma contributes ~0).

CLIP-PATH SQUIRCLE — CLEAR. Pass-4 corrected the false premise: corner-shape:superellipse is Chromium-only behind @supports (squircle.css:39, radius.css:75-78 "Safari/Firefox no positive signal through 2026") — VERIFIED, and clip-path superellipse path is VERIFIED ABSENT in src (born-RED). The cross-engine Safari floor is a clip-path superellipse path with a real corner-pixel getImageData π. Buildable.

BLOOM destRef COLOR CHANNEL — CLEAR. useLiquidReveal clears only transform/transformOrigin/opacity/filter (lines 144-149) — touches ZERO color (verified), so the 4th channel is genuinely net-new AND correctly routed to the DESTINATION FIELD (destRef, the DockStage <Aurora>), preserving the compositor-only floor on the blooming surface. The field re-tint rides the AUR-REACTIVE consumer-side nuclei[].color re-seed.

THE ONE UNDER-SPECIFIED VISUAL WAVE — LENS-SAFARI captured-backdrop-layer (MAJOR). pass-4 itself left this open: "displaces the element's OWN pixels, NOT a live backdrop... 'over a duplicated/captured backdrop layer' is stated but never designed... needs one design pass to be buildable-as-stated." WAVE-LIST:17 names THREE alternatives (background-clip / element() / duplicated-DOM) and commits to NONE. My web check confirms element() is Mozilla-only (-moz-element), DEAD on WebKit — the very target engine — so one stated option is non-realizable and the choice between the remaining two (duplicated-DOM paint-order snapshot vs background-clip) is unmade. The proof:lensing-safari rim-vs-interior getImageData π CANNOT be spec'd until the capture technique is fixed. This is the only mechanism whose paint delta is not yet capturable-as-stated. It is a bounded one-pass fix on a NON-BLOCKING BF-band wave with a viable surviving path (the duplicated-DOM/paint-order sandwich), so it does not re-open a critical; LENS-PRISM (which reads this floor) sequences after it. Every other visual wave has a capturable + Safari-verifiable + G7-revokable paint delta and is sufficient to SPEC.

fixes.fix: COMMIT the captured-backdrop-layer mechanism to ONE buildable technique before develop. element() is verified Mozilla-only (-moz-element, dead on WebKit — the target engine), so DROP it from the three stated alternatives. Spec the duplicated-DOM paint-order sandwich (a sibling clone of the painted backdrop region, positioned identically, with filter:url(#displace) feDisplacementMap over the clone's OWN pixels — feDisplacementMap IS WebKit-supported on the regular filter property, unlike backdrop-filter:url) as the primary; record background-clip as the fallback if the clone proves too costly. The proof:lensing-safari rim-vs-interior getImageData π (rim-concentration ΔL > floor) cannot be authored until this is fixed.

When developing the spec, make the sub-perceptual --split-t swap THRESHOLD explicit + measured (the t-value where opacity-crossfade between the goo veneer and the glass plate hides the SVG-filter↔backdrop-filter handoff with no pop), mirroring morph-bridge.css's opacity clamps (lines 121/146). The constraint + rule are correctly stated; only the threshold NUMBER is deferred to the manual real-Metal capture — fold that capture into the DELTA artefact so the swap-boundary is recorded dev-box truth, not a born-RED auto-gate.

Record in the spec that the demo morph-bridge plates use radial-gradient (NOT backdrop-filter), so the WebKit goo-vs-glass constraint is NOT exercised in the existing demo — the fission PIECES being real glass is what makes the swap load-bearing. The manual real-Safari capture MUST use real glass pieces (backdrop-filter descendants under the goo filter:url() ancestor), not the demo's fake-glass plates, or it certifies the wrong floor.

(3) THE 7 CORRECTIONS-ONLY IDs + LEDGER RE-COUNT. The convergence ledger (:64) still self-reports "Pass 4 ~93%" and the body header claims "38 waves / 11 criticals," but grep finds 37 distinct IDs (one, JUBILANCE-GATE, explicitly folds into proof:jubilance per :50; 2 demoted riders AUR-PRESETS/SEARCH-WELL are sub-items). findings.detail:
RECOMMENDATION: ship all 38 waves as ONE tranche (BE). Do NOT split. Rationale, three load-bearing findings:

(1) THE SIZE PRECEDENT DEMOLISHES THE SPLIT-FOR-MANAGEABILITY ARGUMENT (verified on disk). BC ran 96 waves in ONE tranche and converged 2-consecutive-clean; BB ran 63; BD 43. A 38-wave BE is SMALLER than every recent tranche the project has shipped as a single coherent loop. The split's implicit premise — "38 is too big for one close" — is false against the project's own track record. The close-battery (`gates.mjs --run full`, the deduped local∪ci∪release union, ~318 local / 292 ci / 100 release rows) runs ONCE per tranche cut over the whole tree; splitting into BE+BF pays that full siblings-absent close-battery + the irreversible-tag + the publish/provenance path + a GESTALT-ROSTER re-earn TWICE. The roster (proof:ba-gestalt) is the dominant cost — every visual wave re-earns its dock/glass/aurora verdict on a fresh capture at the W-REFLECT close; splitting means the dock surfaces get gestalt-judged at the BE close, then RE-judged at the BF close after Band-2 glass primitives land underneath them (the pill re-paints once CLEAR-VARIANT/AMBIENT-TINT ship). That is the close-class double-work, not a saving.

(2) THE CUT IS ON THE WRONG SEAM — Band 1 has hard UPWARD dependencies into the proposed BF (the decisive finding). The dock hallmark does NOT ship complete in a Band-1-only BE. Verified from WAVE-LIST + the pass-4 cross-band ledger: BE.W-DOCK-NOWPLAYING-PILL (Band 1, critical) is "the convergence point of FOUR betters-waves" and CONSUMES surface="clear" (CLEAR-VARIANT, Band 2), seeds --glass-ambient-hue (AMBIENT-TINT, Band 2), wires --glass-fill-tint off the album-dominant-hue (TINTED-CHIP, Band 2). BE.W-DOCK-TINTED-CHIP (Band 1) is "the dock-control consumer of --glass-fill-tint" — minted in Band 2's TINTED-CHIP. So a BE=Band1 cut either (a) ships the pill against UN-LANDED primitives (a broken/stubbed hallmark — the exact "source-green/visually-broken" close-class lie the gestalt bar was built to kill), or (b) drags CLEAR-VARIANT + AMBIENT-TINT + TINTED-CHIP UP into BE — at which point BE is no longer "Band 1," it is Band 1 + half of Band 2, and the clean partition has dissolved. The downward dep (AUR-REACTIVE Band 4 → NOWPLAYING-PILL Band 1) is the only one that runs in the split's favored direction; it is outnumbered by the three upward deps. The substrate the split assumes is clean is not: morph-bridge.css (159L, FISSION substrate), DockStack.vue + stack-rail.css (RAIL-REALIZE substrate), useGlassBackdropLuminance.ts (403L, AMBIENT-TINT substrate) all verified present — confirming these are reach-across-band WIRING waves, not isolated band-local builds.

(3) THE ALTERNATIVE SPLIT (BE=dock+glass+aurora visible-hallmark / BF=safari+de-shadcn+jubilance+fold) is ALSO wrong — it severs the tighter coupling. LENS-PRISM reads LENS-SAFARI (Band 2↔Band 7 cross-cut); the goo-split FISSION (Band 1) is BLOCKED-ON VIZ-PARITY-METAL (Band 10) for its real-Safari budget capture; the de-shadcn gate-widen (Band 9) is a regression-lock that must land WITH the form changes it guards, not a tranche later. Safari-compat is the user's #2 creed ("MUST be Safari-compatible") and is woven through EVERY liquid wave — it is not a separable hardening phase, it is a per-wave acceptance condition (proof:safari-liquid asserts each transition degrades gracefully). Deferring de-shadcn+safari+jubilance to BF would ship a BE whose liquid transitions are un-Safari-verified and whose components still carry shadcn FORM — violating two of the four creeds at the BE cut.

WHAT THE SPLIT GETS RIGHT (the honest steelman): the user named the dock THE hallmark, and a BE=dock cut would ship the named centerpiece FIRST — real shippability value. But "ships first" is satisfiable WITHIN one tranche via the EXECUTION-DAG band ordering (Band 1 builds first, its gestalt earns first), without paying a second close-battery and without the broken-pill dependency problem. The dock can be the first BAND to land and paint-verify inside ONE tranche; it does not need its own TRANCHE to be first.

THE ONE legitimate split trigger that is NOT met: a split is correct when the two halves are (a) dependency-acyclic across the cut AND (b) each independently shippable+coherent. Neither holds here — the cut is cyclic (Band1↔Band2 both directions) and Band 1 alone is not a coherent ship (broken pill). When BE.W-VIZ-PARITY-METAL's MANUAL real-Safari-26-Metal capture proves a HARD blocker at execution (the goo-split budget genuinely misses on real Metal and cannot be relaxed), THEN carve the 3 manual-capture-blocked criticals (GOO-SPLIT-PERF, LENS-SAFARI, the FISSION goo-floor) to a BF discharge tranche AT EXECUTION TIME — not a planning-time partition. That is the BD-was-discharge precedent: BD discharged BC's blocked tail; a BF should discharge BE's blocked tail IF one materializes, decided on measured truth, not pre-committed on a band boundary.
